title: Discovering formally verified quantum programs with AI
abstract: arXiv:2611.09822v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: The timeline by which quantum computers can solve breakthrough problems in science depends on improved quantum algorithms as much as on better hardware. Such algorithmic advances are typically achieved through many years of expert human collaboration. In mathematics and computer science, large language models have accelerated progress through automated discovery loops. However, quantum algorithms can only be evaluated by classical computers on restricted or small instances. Here we demonstrate automated discovery of quantum programs beyond these regimes including order-of-magnitude improvements on scientific applications. To achieve this, we build a quantum program library in the Lean theorem prover in which Gemini 4 agents synthesize novel programs against formal problem specifications and verify their correctness and cost. translated_title: 用人工智能发现经形式化验证的量子程序
translated_abstract: 量子计算机何时能够解决科学中的突破性问题，既取决于硬件的改进，也同样取决于量子算法的进步。此类算法进展通常需要专家团队多年的协作才能实现。在数学和计算机科学领域，大型语言模型已通过自动化发现循环加速了研究进展。然而，量子算法只能在受限或小规模的实例上由经典计算机进行评估。在此，我们展示了超越这些限制的量子程序自动化发现，包括在科学应用上取得数量级的改进。为实现这一目标，我们在Lean定理证明器中构建了一个量子程序库，其中Gemini 4智能体根据形式化的问题规范合成新程序，并验证其正确性与成本。智能体团队相互协作，通过维基共享成果与知识，并在组织的会议上讨论想法（摘要至此截断）。
tldr: 该研究在Lean定理证明器中构建量子程序库，由Gemini 4智能体团队根据形式化规范自动合成并验证量子程序的正确性与成本，实现了超越经典仿真能力范围的量子算法自动化发现，并在科学应用上取得数量级的性能提升。
en_tdlr: The authors build a quantum program library in the Lean theorem prover where teams of Gemini 4 agents automatically synthesize novel quantum programs against formal specifications and verify their correctness and cost, enabling automated quantum algorithm discovery beyond the reach of classical simulation and achieving order-of-magnitude improvements on scientific applications.
